title: Phase 55Q records six high-value evidence-gap decisions
summary: FTFN reviewed six gaps against named official records, added five source records and four bounded Published signals, narrowed Arizona power and Ontario permit conversion, advanced Southwest workforce, Ontario delivery, and federal PQC procurement evidence, and placed Arizona wastewater follow-through on a dated hold.
evidence_note: Every selected gap names the authoritative record, the exact stage result, and a stop rule. Service territory is not customer capacity; authorized infrastructure is not accepted operation; consortium formation is not workforce outcome; metropolitan stage counts are not a matched project conversion rate; and procurement guidance is not agency migration.
